cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tucked my ticket in my lapel like you. That gets us in with the curator; I'll introduce you if you hang my exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a cloakroom ticket. I still need an appointment to show her my portfolio.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, coats first. Collect my frames as well and I'll arrange the portfolio appointment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll collect them. Just give me her email and I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct contact costs taking the show down too. Shall I put you down for Sunday?

reason: Replace business card with explicit cloakroom ticket; the copied token no longer implies B already has curator email.
